verdict.rationale: Docs describe a cloud agent that runs tasks in isolated environments, works in parallel, lets you inspect diffs/summaries and open PRs for review, covering build-and-review end-to-end (codex-docs-1,3,5,6). However, explicit 'test' and 'demo' steps aren't directly evidenced, and community feedback highlights inconsistent quality, tight usage limits, slow performance, and reliability caveats that undercut a fully autonomous end-to-end experience.
